extrapolationLogicSoundnessAssessment.reasoning: The mapping (evaluator matchStatus vocabulary -> semantic-coverage coverageState/dangerousReason vocabulary -> safe-failure reasonCode) is an ANALOGY across two structurally different classification systems computed by different algorithms (the frozen atomic matcher vs. semantic-coverage's independent Layer A/B/C detection + reconciliation), not a formal equivalence. This auditor checked the analogy against the underlying real evidence (the sealed labels' own free-text rationale, which names real corresponding/contradicting candidates for each of the 14 controls, not just a bare matchStatus enum value) and finds it directionally reasonable in every case: UNREPRESENTED-with-real-nearby-candidates maps plausibly to semantic-coverage's own UNREPRESENTED/dangerous-unaccounted states; CONTRADICTORY-with-a-named-conflicting-candidate maps plausibly to COMPILED_BUT_MATERIALLY_MISREPRESENTED; HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED-with-an-explicit-surfaced-but-unresolved-candidate maps plausibly to AMBIGUOUS_MATCH. However, this remains an extrapolation through two independently-computed classification systems, and this auditor did NOT build the missing DSGR semantic-coverage fixture to convert it into a literal execution (out of reasonable scope per the charter's own allowance) - so 'all 14 would emit a review event' should continue to be reported as a well-supported reasoned conclusion, not a proven fact, exactly as the prior phase itself framed it.
